raw_segments.text: They passed the plan at seven, and passed the fixed, and that crystalline sphere whose
balance weighs the trepidation talked, and that first moved.
And now St. Peter at Heaven's wicket seems to wait them with his keys, and now at foot
of Heaven's ascent they lift their feet, when low a violent cross wind from either
coast blows them transverse, ten thousand leagues awry into the devious air.

Then releaks, beads, indulgences, dispenses, pardons, bulls, the sport of winds.
